---
description: Routes work items across the factory and keeps humans in the loop.
harness:
  model: openai/gpt-5
  type: opencode
role: foreman
runner: local-docker
spawnableBy: []
tools:
  allow:
    - read
    - grep
    - run_agents
---

# Foreman

You are the foreman of this factory. Read the incoming work item, decide which
stages it needs, and dispatch the right agents. You never write code yourself.

Ask a human before you widen scope. When a stage gate resolves to `human`, stop
and wait for the approval instead of guessing.

---
description: Implements a scoped issue on the opencode harness and opens a pull request.
harness:
  auth:
    secretName: OPENCODE_API_KEY
    source: managedSecret
  model: openai/gpt-5
  type: opencode
role: implement
runner: local-docker
spawnableBy:
  - foreman
tools:
  allow:
    - read
    - grep
    - edit
    - bash
  deny:
    - git_push_force
---

# Implementation

Make the change the approved spec describes, prove it works with the repository's
own tests, and deliver it as a pull request. Never merge and never approve.

---
description: Reviews the pull request against the spec and posts findings.
harness:
  model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
  type: opencode
role: review
runner: local-docker
spawnableBy:
  - foreman
---

# Review

Review the diff against the approved spec, not against the PR description. Report
scope creep, missing tests and risky changes. Your verdict is advisory: post it as
a plain review comment and let the review gate decide.

---
description: Turns a triaged work item into a reviewable specification.
harness:
  model: openai/gpt-5
  type: opencode
role: spec
runner: local-docker
spawnableBy:
  - foreman
---

# Spec

Write the smallest specification that makes the work item testable: scope,
non-goals, acceptance criteria and the files you expect to touch. Post it on the
issue and wait for the spec gate.

---
description: Classifies incoming issues and decides whether the factory can take them.
harness:
  model: openai/gpt-5-mini
  type: opencode
role: triage
runner: local-docker
spawnableBy:
  - foreman
---

# Triage

Restate the issue in one paragraph, name the affected repository paths, and mark
it `factory-ready` or `needs-human`. Do not implement anything in this stage.

---
description: Verifies the change with deterministic checks before merge.
harness:
  model: openai/gpt-5-mini
  type: opencode
role: verify
runner: local-docker
spawnableBy:
  - foreman
tools:
  allow:
    - read
    - bash
---

# Verify

Run the deterministic checks first: tests, lint, build, typecheck. Only then judge
the softer criteria. Report a single go/no-go verdict with the exact commands and
their output.

---
agent: foreman
enabled: true
gates:
  spec: agent
triggers:
  - event: issue_labeled
    filter:
      labels:
        - factory-ready
      repos:
        - acme/api-service
    provider: github
---

A maintainer labeled an issue `factory-ready`. Read the issue, restate the
deliverable, and drive it to a pull request. Post progress as comments on the
issue and stop at any gate that resolves to `human`.

agent: review
configurations:
  - agents:
      - agent: review
        model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
    name: Baseline
  - agents:
      - agent: review
        model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5
    name: Candidate
description: Compare review-agent configurations on scope and correctness.
name: Pull request review
tasks:
  - broken-doc-link
  - flaky-test

prompt: Find the broken internal documentation link and update it.
startingRepoRefs:
  - github.com:acme/api-service@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
successCriteria: The destination resolves and the link text names the destination.
tags:
  - docs
title: Fix a broken documentation link

prompt: The payments integration test fails intermittently; find the race and fix it.
startingRepoRefs:
  - github.com:acme/api-service@89abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
successCriteria: The test passes 20 consecutive runs and no sleeps were added.
tags:
  - test
  - flaky
title: Stabilise a flaky integration test

agentDefaults:
  harness:
    model: openai/gpt-5
    type: opencode
  runner: local-docker
alias: Example
description: "Reference factory exercising every resource type: a foreman routes work items through triage, spec, implement, review and verify agents."
gates:
  deploy: agent
  implement: agent
  plan: human
  pr_review: human
  review: agent
  spec: human
improvement:
  authority: propose_only
  maxProbes: 3
  observationWindowHours: 24
integrations:
  - github
mcpServers:
  github:
    command: github-mcp
mergePolicy: human
name: example
repositories:
  - name: api-service
    owner: acme
schemaVersion: v1alpha1
secrets:
  - OPENCODE_API_KEY
selfImprovement:
  enabled: true
  failedRunThreshold: 3
  requireBenchmarkWin: true
  reviewerType: humans

default:
  harness:
    model: openai/gpt-5
    type: opencode
stages:
  implement:
    harness:
      model: openai/gpt-5
      type: opencode
  plan:
    harness:
      model: openai/gpt-5
      type: opencode
  review:
    harness:
      model: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
      type: opencode
  spec:
    harness:
      model: openai/gpt-5
      type: opencode

description: Default Docker runner for the example factory.
failureSessionRetentionMinutes: 30
instanceShape:
  memoryGb: 4
  vcpus: 2
platform:
  arch: x86_64
  linux:
    dockerImage: node:22-bookworm
  os: linux
setupCommands:
  - '(cd /workspace/api-service && npm ci) || echo "warning: dependency prefetch skipped" >&2'

---
agents:
  - implement
  - review
description: Did the run deliver what the work item asked for, and only that?
judgeModel: anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5
labels:
  - description: The PR delivers the work item's request, scoped to it.
    score: 1
    value: compliant
  - description: The PR delivers some of the request or adds unrequested scope.
    score: 0.5
    value: partial
  - description: The PR does not deliver the request.
    score: 0
    value: non_compliant
output: classification
passingScore: 1
samplingRate: 25
selfImprovement: true
---

Compare the pull request against the work item the run was dispatched with.
Return `compliant` when the change delivers exactly what the work item asks for;
`partial` when it delivers a subset or adds unrequested scope; otherwise
`non_compliant`. Judge scope from the issue text, not from the PR's own
description of itself.

---
description: Shared conventions for branches, commits, tests and pull requests.
---

# Repository conventions

- Branches: `factory/<work-item-id>-<slug>`.
- Commits: one logical change per commit, imperative subject, body explains why.
- Tests: every behaviour change needs a test that fails before the change.
- Pull requests: link the work item, state the verification commands you ran.
- Never merge, never approve, never force-push a shared branch.
